title: Look up dining hours and email them

inbox.subject: This week's deals: 40% off at Antonio's + more
inbox.body:
Hey Alex, here's what's on sale around campus this week:

- Antonio's Pizza: 40% off any large pie with student ID, Mon–Wed
- Amherst Books: buy two used textbooks, get the third free
- Collective Fitness: first month for $19

See you next week,
The Campus Deals team

inbox.subject: This week at Worcester Dining
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Theme night this Thursday is Taste of Thailand at Worcester. Late night at Berkshire now runs until midnight on weekdays. The grab-and-go line at Hampshire is closed Saturday for maintenance.

Enjoy your meals!
UMass Dining
